extDescription.message: Exact screenshots of anything on a page. Nothing leaves your machine.

restrictedBrowserPage.message: Chrome does not allow extensions to run on its own pages, so Hotshot cannot capture this one. Switch to a normal web page and try again.
restrictedBrowserPage.description: Shown for chrome://, about:, devtools: and view-source: URLs

restrictedWebStore.message: Chrome blocks all extensions on the Web Store, so Hotshot cannot capture this page. Your browser’s built-in screenshot shortcut still works here.

restrictedExtensionPage.message: This is another extension’s page, and Chrome keeps extensions out of each other’s pages. Hotshot cannot capture it.

restrictedPdf.message: This is Chrome’s built-in PDF viewer, which extensions cannot read. Download the PDF and open it in a PDF app to capture from it.

restrictedUnknown.message: Hotshot cannot read this tab’s address, so it cannot tell whether capturing here is allowed. Reload the page and try again.

hintElement.message: hover an element · [ ] to adjust · click to capture · esc cancel

notionNotShared.message: Notion cannot see that page. Open it, choose ••• → Connections, and invite the Hotshot integration — then try again.
notionNotShared.description: Notion 404. The single most valuable error message in the product: the page exists, the integration simply was not invited.
